---
title: "Wood Provision"
---

This site documents, step by step and in R, the update of the **wood provision ecosystem service** for
the European Union. Wood provision is the contribution of forest ecosystems to the growth of trees
that can be used as timber. The work follows the accounting approach of the EU Knowledge Innovation
Project on an Integrated system of Natural Capital and ecosystem services Accounting (INCA).

Each page is a runnable document, so the procedure can be inspected and repeated from the repository.

- [Wood provision](documentation/methods/wood-provision/index.qmd) builds the physical accounts. It
  estimates the net annual increment of forest available for wood supply by country for 2000 to 2024,
  compares it with removals to flag overuse, and maps it at 1 km and 100 m resolution over the forest of each year,
  weighted by the productivity of the vegetation.
- [Monetary valuation](documentation/methods/monetary-valuation/index.qmd) gives that flow a value in
  euro, in current and constant (2010) prices, and maps it.

The tables and maps produced are available for download at the end of each page. The 100 m maps are too large
for the repository and are kept in an external folder.
